signatures.head: def horn (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) : (Δ[n] : SSet.{u}).Subcomplex where
lemma mem_horn_iff {n : ℕ} (i : Fin (n + 1)) {m : SimplexCategoryᵒᵖ} (x : Δ[n].obj m) : x ∈ (horn n i).obj m ↔ Set.range (stdSimplex.asOrderHom x) ∪ {i} ≠ Set.univ := Iff.rfl
lemma horn_eq_iSup (n : ℕ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) : horn.{u} n i = ⨆ (j : ({i}ᶜ : Set (Fin (n + 1)))), stdSimplex.face {j.1}ᶜ
lemma horn_ι_mem_J (n : ℕ) [NeZero n] (i : Fin (n + 1)) : J (horn.{u} n i).ι
noncomputable def skeletalEquivalence : SimplexCategory ≌ NonemptyFinLinOrd := Functor.asEquivalence skeletalFunctor

def cartesianFibrations : MorphismProperty SSet.{u} := fun X B p ↦ innerFibrations p ∧ ∀ (x : X _⦋0⦌) (e : (Δ[1] : SSet.{u}) ⟶ B), stdSimplex.δ 0 ≫ e = SSet.yonedaEquiv.symm (p.app (Opposite.op ⦋0⦌) x) → ∃ f : (Δ[1] : SSet.{u}) ⟶ X, stdSimplex.δ 0 ≫ f = SSet.yonedaEquiv.symm x ∧ f ≫ p = e ∧ IsCartesianEdge p (SSet.yonedaEquiv f)

def cocartesianFibrations : MorphismProperty SSet.{u} := fun X B p ↦ innerFibrations p ∧ ∀ (x : X _⦋0⦌) (e : (Δ[1] : SSet.{u}) ⟶ B), stdSimplex.δ 1 ≫ e = SSet.yonedaEquiv.symm (p.app (Opposite.op ⦋0⦌) x) → ∃ f : (Δ[1] : SSet.{u}) ⟶ X, stdSimplex.δ 1 ≫ f = SSet.yonedaEquiv.symm x ∧ f ≫ p = e ∧ IsCocartesianEdge p (SSet.yonedaEquiv f)
